        A clear view of where you are and what to practise next.

        A short diagnostic, progressing level by level

        We evaluate what can be graded honestly without guessing: grammar, vocabulary, reading and professional communication (recognition). The placement starts at A1 and stops at the first level you do not pass, with a maximum of 20 questions. Results are provisional, with low confidence. Speaking is not required and does not affect your result while listening and speaking remain in validation.

        Four questions per level

        AI-generated audio · 2 plays left

        Your recording is sent securely to OpenAI for transcription and feedback. English to Work does not store the raw audio; it saves the transcript, structured evaluation, feedback and audit metadata.
